procedure: Pages rendered with pdfplumber page.to_image(resolution=220); the five pages are LANDSCAPE-GENUINE (raw ~2420x1875 renders read upright directly, no transpose -- cache/2026-scan-assessment/tier1/oktibbeha/). Every in-scope row's cross-page cell sum equals its printed TOTAL exactly (16/16; the X-celled rows' blanks are proven 0 by their own printed TOTALs).
structure_note: Five-page shape with a table-B extension: p1 the certification/signature page; p2+p3 = table A over the county's 19 precincts (11 columns, then North Starkville District 3/Oktibbeha Co Storm Shelter/Oktoc/Osborn/Sessums/South Adaton/South Longview/South Starkville/Sturgis + TOTAL) carrying Senate, BOTH congressional districts' sections, and Chancery 14's two printed places; p4+p5 = table B over the same column split carrying Circuit 16's Places 1-3 and the local sections. NOTE the FIRST BOTH-DISTRICT county: this sheet prints US House Of Rep 01-1st Congressional District (Johnny Baucom / Cliff Johnson / Trent Kelly, X-celled with values ONLY in Double Springs, Maben and Sturgis precincts -- Oktibbeha's House 1 portion) AND US House Of Rep 03-3rd Congressional District (Michael A. Chiaradio / Michael Guest / Erik Klehle, X-celled at Double Springs and Maben, with Sturgis column values 0). Races: U.S. Senate; US House Of Rep 01-1st Congressional District; US House Of Rep 03-3rd Congressional District; Chancery Court 14-1-Chancery District 14-1 (Rodney P. Faver -- X at Bell Schoolhouse + Oktoc/Osborn/Sessums); Chancery Court 14-3-Chancery District 14-3 (Paula Drungole-Ellis -- X at Craig Springs/Central-West/East-West/North-West? no -- values at Cairo/Caradine/Hickory Grove/Iuka/Tibbee on p2 and Oktibbeha Co Shelter/Oktoc/Osborn/Sessums/South Starkville on p3, X elsewhere); Circuit Court 16-Circuit District 16 Place 1 (James 'Jim' Thomas Kitchens Jr.), Place 2 (Lee J. 'Jay' Howard), Place 3 (Michelle Easterling) -- the same Circuit 16 roster Noxubee/Lowndes/Clay print, names identical. Printed totals: Colom 9539, Hyde-Smith 6008, Pinkins 179, Baucom 20, Johnson 337, Kelly 799, Chiaradio 8343, Guest 5889, Klehle 154, Faver 7584, Drungole-Ellis 5410, Kitchens 12862, Howard 12941, Easterling 12686.
operator_rows_note: All 16 in-scope rows supplied by operator_rows in ballot order; table-A rows carry p2+p3 cells + the p3 printed TOTAL; the Circuit 16 rows carry p4+p5 cells + the p5 printed TOTAL. The X-celled rows supply only the numeric cells plus the printed TOTAL (House 1: Baucom 4+6+10 = 20, Johnson 70+94+173 = 337, Kelly 290+70+439 = 799; House 3: the numeric cells minus Double Springs/Maben; Chancery 14-1 Faver: 52+152+329+165+265+127+121+396+540+157+1082+1721+301+119+1531+526 = 7584; 14-3 Drungole-Ellis: 235+548+866+636+120+30+601+631+676+1067 = 5410) -- the X-marked blanks become 0 under the row's own printed TOTAL, the established X-cell rule.
truncation_note: No truncations; the nineteen precinct headers print complete (Bell Schoolhouse, Central Starkville, Craig Springs, Double Springs, East Starkville, Hickory Grove, Maben, Needmore, North Adaton, North Longview, North Starkville District 2, North Starkville District 3, Oktibbeha Co Storm Shelter, Oktoc, Osborn, Sessums, South Adaton, South Longview, South Starkville, Sturgis -- the sheet's own SEMS two-precinct Starkville split kept verbatim).
local_note: p4/p5 carry the local sections after Circuit 16 Place 3: 'Oktibbeha-County Court Judge' (C. Marty Haug, Lee Ann Self Turner), 'Election Commissioner Dist 1-County Election Commissioner' (Sheryl Elmore), 'Consolidated AT-STARKVILLE OKTIBBEHA CONSOLIDATED SCHOOL BOARD 1' (Maggie J. Cooks, Cassandra Palmer) -- all local, out of scope, contributing no parse rows on operator-supply pages. Chancery 14's two printed Places (1 and 3) write Place-qualified labels (matching the other Chancery 14 counties; the place spread covered by the accepted_roster_divergences declarations); Circuit 16's three Places write Place-qualified labels (matching Noxubee/Lowndes/Clay); House 1 and House 3 write their districted labels (House 1 matching the other House 1 counties).
